name: unknot_bare
description: Bare unknot carrier, N_link=1 -- STABLE three rungs below EHN's floor (pre-reg criteria passed). The undressed carrier
validity: 24k steps: Lk=-1.000, det=1 single comp, Q healed -0.89, el ~20 alive. E=931.3.
caveats: engine-static: stationary only under the recorded integrator (outline §5); re-settle in any other stepper
labels are field-state names, not K7-compendium rows nor SM particles (COMPENDIUM.md)
label_policy: knot-theoretic labels only: the NWT carrier-to-particle mapping was not established (see jax-solitons COMPENDIUM.md, 'Walk-knot versus carrier-knot': lifting walks to 3-D embeddings gives mostly the unknot, <=14% agreement with the carrier), and soliton-playground's charter forbids identifying any structure with a Standard Model particle. Geometry and every measured quantity are unchanged.
provenance_note: Produced in null-worldtube-private (see relaxation.git_commit). Description relabelled 2026-07-29 to knot-theoretic terms; measurements untouched. relaxation.source_out_dir is RETAINED VERBATIM (out_lepton_bare_n192) because it is a historical filesystem path, not a physics claim -- that directory really is where these bytes were written, and rewriting it to satisfy a label policy would falsify the provenance rather than honour the charter.
